title: Bedrock Holes
description: Finally a way to get past the bedrock without using glitches!
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc33e58ca4ca6fbecb887feab9e84d353f44097d.png) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Discord-Button-64.png)](https://discord.gg/hFS6faY9tW) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Modrinth-Button-64.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrock-holes)
This mod generates holes in the bedrock. They are RARE, but if you don't want to use glitches or if you're stuck above the Nether roof, they may be what you need. ![A bedrock hole](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9d8356d6f8626b52ccc6027b6af4db45069787a.png) Created using [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/).
